home_hero_desc: One click, one site. Explore the internet based on your interests, vote for what you love, and keep the gems.
home_dashboard_subtitle: Click Stumble to discover a site based on your interests.
home_feat_stumble_desc: One button, and you land on a site you'd never have searched for.
home_feat_vote_desc: Thumbs up or down — the algorithm learns your taste with every click.
home_feat_favorites_desc: Sites you like are automatically saved so you can come back to them.
interests_desc: Choose at least 3 topics to personalise your discoveries.
settings_interests_desc: Update the topics that shape your discoveries.
settings_content_langs_desc: Choose which languages of sites you want to see. By default, all sites appear regardless of language.
settings_lang_desc: Choose the language you want to use the site in.
error_password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error_user_exists: This username or email is already taken.
error_too_many: Too many attempts, please try again in 15 minutes.
error_new_password_short: New password must be at least 8 characters.
favorites_empty: You have no favorites yet. Start stumbling and vote 👍 to save sites!
submit_desc: Suggest a site you find remarkable. It will be reviewed before appearing in the pool.
submit_url_hint: Must start with https:// or http://
submit_description_placeholder: In one or two sentences, what makes this site remarkable?
submit_success: Thank you! Your site has been submitted and will be reviewed shortly.
error_url_invalid: Invalid URL. It must start with http:// or https://.
error_url_no_ip: URLs pointing to an IP address are not accepted.
error_url_private: This URL points to a private or local network address.
error_url_duplicate: This site is already in our catalogue.
error_submit_categories: Please check at least one category.
error_submit_unverified: You must verify your email address before submitting a site.
error_submit_daily_limit: You have reached the limit of 3 submissions per day.
error_submit_weekly_limit: You have reached the limit of 10 submissions per week.
error_submit_pending_limit: You already have a submission awaiting moderation.
error_captcha: Anti-robot verification failed. Please try again.
submit_unverified_warning: Please verify your email address to submit sites.
verify_success_desc: Your email address has been confirmed. You can now submit sites.
verify_invalid: This verification link is invalid or has already been used.
report_reason_placeholder: Reason (optional): spam, dead link, inappropriate content…
report_sent: Thank you, your report has been recorded.
report_already: You have already reported this site.
stumble_less_of_this_title: Decrease the weight of these categories in my discoveries
legal_s1_body: StumbleClone is a personal project published by Dany (dany@danux.be), hosted at stumble.danux.be.
legal_s2_body: The site is self-hosted on a personal server in Belgium.
legal_s3_body: The StumbleClone source code is open-source. Linked sites belong to their respective owners. To request removal of a link, use the site removal page.
privacy_s2_items: Email address and username (account)|Password (hashed, never in plain text)|Interests and preference weights|Votes (👍/👎) on sites|Internal browsing history (sites viewed)|Sites submitted for moderation|Preferred language
privacy_s3_body: Data is used solely to operate the site discovery service (legal basis: contract performance, Art. 6.1.b GDPR). No data is sold or shared with third parties.
privacy_s4_body: Data is kept as long as the account exists. After account deletion, all personal data is removed within 48 hours. Aggregated statistics (anonymized votes) may be retained.
privacy_s5_items: Access: export your data from Settings → My data|Rectification: edit your profile in Settings|Erasure: delete your account from Settings|Portability: the export provides a standard JSON file
privacy_s5_contact: To exercise your rights or for any question:
privacy_s6_body: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Data Protection Authority (APD) if you feel your rights are not being respected.
optout_desc: You own a site listed on StumbleClone and want it removed? Fill in this form. Your request will be processed within 7 business days.
optout_url: URL of the site to remove
optout_email_hint: So we can confirm the processing of your request.
optout_reason_placeholder: Why do you want to remove this site from the catalogue?
optout_success: Your request has been recorded. We will process it within 7 business days.
optout_already: A request is already pending for this URL.
settings_data_desc: In accordance with GDPR, you can export all your data or delete your account.
settings_delete_warning: This action is irreversible. Your account, votes, interests and history will be permanently deleted.
tastes_desc: Adjust the weight of each theme to fine-tune your discoveries. A high weight (2.0) promotes the theme, a low weight (0.1) reduces it.
stumble_blocked: This site blocks embedding in a frame.
forgot_desc: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot_sent: If that address is registered, you'll receive an email shortly. Check your spam folder too.
reset_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please submit a new request.
reset_success: Password changed successfully. You can now log in.
